text:
Sam Johnson: Heads-up — GreenBridge (POC) just asked for SOC 2 artifacts + a signed pen-test authorization and a single evidence bundle. Also asking whether dedicated pricing changes if we provide staging IPs/longer retention. Can we scope? /cc @Maya Chen @Rohit Patel
Maya Chen: Thanks Sam. Do they want full control-plane logs or just attestation PDFs (SOC 2 report summary + ISO cert) and a pen-test letter?
Sam Johnson: Their note: 'all attestation PDFs + pen-test letter + brief network diagram for any on-prem nodes'. Prefer one ZIP or an SFTP drop.
Rohit Patel: We can provide the SOC 2 summary and ISO27001 certificate. Pen-test letter needs SecOps sign-off. Important: do NOT provide production creds. Propose short-lived staging creds + scoped IP allowlist. @Marcy Lee can you provision a staging tenant?
Marcy Lee: I can spin up a staging tenant with ephemeral creds. ETA ~24h if infra is green. I'll need a ticket with customer contact + allowed IP ranges and desired test window.
Sam Johnson: Customer contact: j.santos@greenbridge.ai. They said procurement wants a single bundle for review. Also asked if providing staging IPs or special retention would change Dedicated pricing (they're evaluating dedicated for residency).
Maya Chen: Dedicated is a separate commit — staging for a pen-test usually doesn't change price unless they demand reserved capacity, longer retention, or dedicated on-prem nodes. Ask them to confirm expected qps/retention.
Ava Morales: We can sign our standard pen-test authorization and provide a vendor-facing letter. I'll prepare a redline-friendly template; we'll need their legal to sign too. Recommend a short MSA addendum for evidence delivery if they want retained archives longer than our standard.
Rohit Patel: For the test itself we need: scope doc from their vendor, exact IP ranges, allowed vectors, and the test window. Also we require the third-party to provide an attestation (signed) stating they followed an agreed scope — we don't hand over raw red team reports. Security note: strip any customer PII from logs and only deliver high-level audit summaries.
Sam Johnson: They asked if we can deliver via presigned S3 link. Is that acceptable?
Marcy Lee: Presigned S3 is fine. I can do SFTP if they prefer. Workflow I suggest: 1) we create staging tenant & generate evidence bundle, 2) upload to our staging S3, 3) generate time-limited presigned GET link and share with customer. Example upload snippet I use for internal ops:
```
aws s3 cp soc2_iso_bundle_greenbridge.zip s3://redwood-evidence-staging/GB-314/ --acl private
```
I'll create the presigned PUT/GET after the bundle is ready.
Rohit Patel: Also add a checksum (sha256) and a signed manifest listing included docs (SOC 2 summary, ISO cert, pen-test authorization signed by Redwood).
Sam Johnson: Timing: can we get pen-test authorization template + SOC 2 summary by EOD tomorrow? GreenBridge needs it for procurement review.
Ava Morales: I'll DM a draft pen-test authorization and MSA addendum by EOD. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: New evidentiary drop scheduled: GB-314. Ticket #3247 created (assign to Marcy Lee).
